frequency_question: How often do announced indefinite union strikes successfully commence on or before the stated deadline rather than being deferred, called off, or settled?
membership_rule: Members are all instances where a major national union federation formally announced an indefinite strike deadline. Excluded are local wildcat strikes, single-day symbolic strikes, or disputes without a formal indefinite strike call.

coverage_note: 8 named major Indian trade union and bank union strike call instances; representative of similar past disputes.
known_gaps: Some smaller regional bank union notices may be unrecorded in this macro set.

validity_reason: Labor relations patterns and conciliation mechanisms evolve slowly over decades.
